references.text: The parallel list of unclean birds in Leviticus also mentions the owl (כּוֹס), the great horned owl (יַנְשׁוּף), and the little owl (תִּנְשָׁמֶת) as unclean birds that must not be eaten.
The continuation of the list of unclean birds in Leviticus, which supplements and confirms the prohibition against eating these birds mentioned in Deuteronomy.

Isaiah mentions the hedgehog (קִפּוֹד) and other creatures of the wilderness that will dwell in ruined cities, illustrating the symbolic meaning of these animals as signs of destruction and desolation.
